sound_card.device: Creative Labs Sound Blaster 16 or AWE32

method: COPYIT.BAT from the CD, run as 'COPYIT <cd drive> <install dir>', then INSTALL.EXE writes DEFAULT.CFG, VIDEO.BAT and DIG.INI

stays_on_cd.VIDEO/INTROSND.RPL: the intro video (Hangnail's song); VIDEO.BAT plays it from the CD
stays_on_cd.audio tracks 2-38: the music, played as CD audio while the game runs
